LibraryCatalog.title: LibraryCatalog
LibraryCatalog.description: Master catalog state containing shelves JSON, books order/metadata JSON, and Google Drive sync references.

shelvesJson.description: Serialized JSON array of library shelves.

booksMetaJson.description: Serialized JSON array of books metadata without heavy page payloads.

bookOrderJson.description: Serialized JSON array of ordered book IDs.

deletedBookIdsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of permanently deleted book IDs.

driveFolderId.description: Google Drive folder ID where book files and database are stored.

driveCatalogFileId.description: Google Drive file ID for elibrary-catalog-db.json.

updatedBy.description: Administrator email who updated the catalog.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last catalog sync.

LibraryBook.title: LibraryBook
LibraryBook.description: Individual book record including cover image, metadata, and Google Drive file references.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages in the book.

passwordProtected.description: Whether the book requires a password to read.

hasCustomCoverImage.description: Whether the book uses an original cover image.

isCustomPdf.description: Whether the book is an uploaded original PDF or image flipbook.

pdfUrl.description: Direct public PDF or Google Drive stream URL.

editablePagesJson.description: Serialized JSON array of lightweight page text metadata.

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID for the book JSON bundle.

drivePdfFileId.description: Google Drive file ID for raw PDF file.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last update.

LibraryBookPage.title: LibraryBookPage
LibraryBookPage.description: Individual rendered page of a book for 3D Flipbook display across accounts.

dataUrl.description: Rendered page DataURL or image URL.

isOriginalPdfPage.description: Whether this page is an original PDF/image page.

/library_catalog/{catalogId}.description: Global library catalog state containing shelves, book index, and Google Drive database IDs.

/library_books/{bookId}.description: Book records with cover images and Google Drive file references.

/library_pages/{pageDocId}.description: Individual rendered flipbook pages for cross-account reading.
